title: Degree of tensor train varieties via integral geometry
abstract: Applies integral-geometry / Crofton machinery directly to tensor-train (MPS) varieties to compute their algebraic degree, with an accompanying Julia package.
key_claims: Rigorous integral-geometry measure native to tensor-network parameter space.
Candidate fresh angle for the Crofton route (HYP-014/022 REFUTED only for the naive sin(pi*dr/N) boundary-length discretization).
Does NOT itself revive HYP-014/022 -- no alpha/transport/force claim; a methods lead only.
